_purpose: EXACT, exploratory (series paper 5; docs/papers/series_plan.md). With interchangeable points the weight of placing two identical defects in a flat 12 x 12 torus is the arrangement's symmetry count A. Written before the run: we expect A to be 1 or 2 at ordinary separations and larger only at special placements (exactly opposite across the torus), so that counting makes no pull that grows as defects approach. A four-placement smoke run in the scratchpad gave 2, 4, 1, 4 at shifts (2,0), (6,0), (4,4), (6,6), and is disclosed here.
name: exact_pair_symmetry
